whisper.label: Whisper Large-V3
whisper.text: This is a 360 degree multiplex hologram created by Lloyd Cross as part of the collection of Sharon McCormick. Its title is Dolly Painting Gala. It was created in 1976 by Lloyd Cross for Salvador Dali and Selwyn Lissick. You can see that the entire hologram is comprised of a 360 degree view of a set rotating. As we take a look at the overlap that is created, you can see that it's a continuous shot. And the detail is very clearly evident that this is Salvador Dali painting Gala in a set, a setting that he devised for holography. A closer view of this might reveal some of the more intricacies of this setting, as well as the vertical stripes that were used in the multiplex process in the 1970s. This hologram is part of the collection of Sharon McCormick Collection and Archives, administered by Al Rizutis, who shot this video in 2D and as well as stereo 3D. Now we can just sit back and watch it.
